archived_renderings.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: full-belt urban-design competition aerial for Beijing Jing-Zhang Borrowed Intelligence. Generate ONE new wide high-resolution architectural masterplan bird's-eye perspective of the ENTIRE urban belt, not a single courtyard. Input 1 is the primary GEOGRAPHIC COMPOSITION reference: preserve the oblique district layout, relative road/rail/water geometry, and the three colored node centers. North is at the distant UPPER RIGHT, south at the LOWER LEFT foreground; the full old railway public-space spine spans the complete view. Input 2 is the southern Dazhongsi material/landscape style reference, not the whole-belt layout.
The long narrow continuous-proposal public-space spine links three separated neighborhoods: distant northern Zhongzhiyuan civic validation commons (teal reference circle), middle AI Origin everyday shared courts (ochre circle), southern Dazhongsi transit/culture/ordinary street life (purple circle). Retain the long stretches of ordinary Beijing urban fabric between these nodes. The whole belt from Beijing North Railway Station in the south toward Qinghe/North Fifth Ring in the north must be in frame. Western campuses and street fabric, eastern city fabric and Xiaoyue River, and the northern Qinghe transverse water corridor remain at their reference positions. Show small human-scale public forecourts, linear memory paving, shaded paths and modest brick/stone reused ground-floor interfaces along the proposal spine. No massive new towers, floating ring roads, impossible bridges, new lakes, giant garden complexes, futuristic neon, holograms, or landscaped deck crossing an active road/railway.
Style: refined urban-design competition visualization, very high aerial perspective, editorial architectural realism with a gently diagrammatic masterplan quality; existing city blocks largely neutral pale warm gray, green corridor and three specific commons rich but restrained, muted autumn greenery, subtle terracotta accents, fine paths and public-space grain visible, soft daylight and crisp atmospheric depth without obscuring the far north. Building heights are conceptual low/medium illustrative massing, not surveyed data. Urban scale should feel many kilometers, not one campus. Reference circle markers must become three recognizable spatial places; DO NOT draw colored rings, bounding boxes, connector arrows, labels, text, logos, watermark or map legend in the image. Keep the full masterplan composition, with all three places and long connecting urban corridor readily legible. Designed corridor is a concept proposal, not a photo of present-day conditions. Wide landscape composition approximately 16:10; fill the image with city and the entire long belt, little empty border.
archived_renderings.reference_role: GIS composition guide; not georeferenced image validation
archived_renderings.limitations: Illustrative heights, texture and landscaping. No survey, cadastral, route, construction or access validation.

overall_revision.camera: Matched overall day and night aerials, southern foreground and northern distance
overall_revision.focus: Three concept focus outlines and continuous public spine
